> This work presents the development of a low-cost smart glasses system designed to assist with spatial navigation and accident prevention. The prototype utilizes an ESP32-S3 microcontroller to manage a transparent OLED display, which functions as a Head-Up Display (HUD) by projecting directional arrows and status icons directly into the user's field of view without obstructing the surroundings. The system operates in conjunction with a web application (React) running on a smartphone, which handles GPS route processing and transmits simplified commands to the device via Bluetooth. For active safety, the hardware incorporates a VL53L0X laser sensor for the immediate detection of physical obstacles.
